_readme: S714 (rios, lane 1), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45161770730): 4 programs of Sacramento City College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and whose own section the 2026-27 catalog does not print. Free page read 45167465999 printed every page of the hand-filed catalog (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/sacramento_city.json, sha256 pinned); the college's other 18 programs on the lever are pinned in its reconcile entry (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, pdf_pages). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read: no page holds their requirements. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none, d-load-skips-places-none-s697). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI. 30620 was pinned at first and dropped on the second reader's finding (PR #3715): the section its pin read is Mathematics 2.0 46304's.

reasons.credit_not_in_catalog: A credit program the 2026-27 catalog prints under no heading of its own: no page of the hand-filed file names its title with its award, and the department's list of degrees and certificates does not list it.
reasons.ge_pattern_certificate: General-education pattern certificate. It has no fixed course list by design (the census's named gap, kb/_harvest_gap_census.py NAMED_GAPS).
reasons.teach_out_successor_printed: A program the state's file marks Active - Teachout Only, whose 2026-27 catalog prints only its successor's section: the department's list of degrees names the successor and not it.

programs.note: No page prints 'iOS'; the Computer Information Science department's list of awards (PDF p.262) does not name it, and the record was read from p.277.

programs.title: Cardiovascular Technologist
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
programs.note: The Cardiovascular Technologist department (PDF p.231) prints its overview and then 'Cardiovascular Technologist (CVT) Courses' with no list of degrees and certificates and no certificate section; pp.231-234 are course descriptions.

programs.title: Intersegmental GE Transfer Curriculum (IGETC)
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
programs.note: The state lists 342 courses; the catalog prints IGETC only as a transfer pattern in its graduation and transfer pages (PDF pp.81-99). The census names this gap by its title.

programs.title: Mathematics
programs.note: The Program Course File marks 30620 Active - Teachout Only.
